blindSummary: Capital-region metropolitan unit: the entire scene (NGOs including a national LGBT organisation), anonymity of 10 million people; the main visitor districts show a typical large-city urban climate. Its own sources sharpen the picture: a parliamentary committee unanimously approved bills barring trans people from public toilets of the sex assigned at birth (Feb 2025; the plenary approved the fused text in April 2025, with custody, medical, caregiving and disability exceptions), and the international airport relabeled its bathrooms to "women in their diversity / men in their diversity" after a 2023 complaint. A university observatory counted 54 LGBTQ+ killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023, 30 of the dead trans women; in Feb 2023 a 31-year-old trans sex worker was abducted from a central street by a criminal gang and shot dead.
blindSourceSummaries: A national newspaper (Feb 2025): the parliamentary committee on women and family affairs unanimously approved the committee report of bills barring entry to public toilets of the sex opposite to birth sex, with exceptions for custody, medical care, accompanying an elderly person, a child under 12 or a disabled person, and banning ambiguous bathroom signage; still required plenary backing. Recounts the 2023 international-airport bathroom-signage complaint ('women in their diversity / men in their diversity') and quotes an activist calling the measure discriminatory.

A university human-rights institute analysis (April 2025): on 2 April 2025 the plenary approved, waiving a second vote, the law strengthening the sexual integrity of children and adolescents (fused bills aimed at protecting the integrity of minors under 14), whose text openly discriminates against trans and non-binary people by restricting access to hygiene services matching their gender identity.

A regional LGBT news outlet (July 2024): a university observatory's annual report counted 54 LGBTQ+ killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023 — over half the dead were trans women (30), then gay men (23), one lesbian; 2023 the deadliest year (19 killings, 12 trans women); violations peaked in 2020 (61 reports); extreme cruelty documented. Details the Feb 2023 case of a trans sex worker (31): abducted from a central street by a criminal gang, taken to another district and shot dead.
blindTangential: Gay men account for 23 of the 54 killings counted 2020-2023 — a violence pattern specific to gay men that shapes the security climate without being directed at gender expression as such.
